en.title: Minimum Matching Distance Between Safe Centers and Destinations
en.description:
Match n centers with n destinations one-to-one; each pair costs the absolute difference of their coordinates. Find the minimum total cost.

Standard input/output, examples and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's do not claim to be the source's original limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), the second line contains n center coordinates, and the third line contains n destination coordinates, all in 1..10⁹.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: after sorting, pair 1→2, 2→4 and 2→5, for a distance of 1+2+3=6. Example 2: the only distance is 8. Example 3: identical coordinates are paired with each other, costing 0.
hints: Sort the two sets of coordinates separately and pair elements at the same sorted position.
